adaptations: NX-038 E1 (design §4.2 steps 3, 5, 6; D3 selective port): the evaluation gate and the adapter result contract are ported; the session lifecycle is rewritten as rules only. Nothing of the workspace storage, runtime, MCP, workflow, plugins, benchmarks, visualization or assets is copied (evo-ontology-source-audit §4.2). Each file keeps the MIT copyright line in its header.

files.change: EvaluationGate kept; anonymize reproducible (explicit swap or seeded random.Random, swap recorded); decide_gt takes the frozen non-inferiority margin (D7, an equal score never accepts) and checks paired finite scores with unique case ids
subject is a candidate id or the Parent revision, cases are frozen case ids, no output path hint; artifact_refs instead of artifact_paths

only the lifecycle rules (frozen round budget, reject keeps running, legitimate incomplete reasons with the minimum rejects, budget extension only upward, the publication gate input checks); no workspace, SemanticStore, validate() or publication: acceptance ends in accepted_for_release, never a published or active version; one upstream run maps to a chain of NexLoop candidates
